abstract: One hundred ninety patients with germ cell line testicular tumours were treated according to the modified Einhorn scheme. The response rate was 67.9%. The most favourable results were found in the embryonal histologic type (RR = 76.9%) in the biological markers (beta-HCG and AFP) negative (RR = 97.4%) and in the minimal pulmonary extent group (RR = 94.1%). The authors treated 112 patients with including these VPB-resistant germ cell testicular tumour and those with recurrence after this treatment. The patients' mean age was 28.8 (limits 19 to 44) years. Patients were given Vepeside (100 mg/m in infusion for days 1-5), Adriablastin (40 mg/m in infusion on day 1) and Cisplatin (20 mg/m in infusion) for day 1-5. The treatment resulted in CR with 18 patients (16.1%) and PR with 42 (37.5%) (RR = 53.6%). The best results were obtained with the seminoma patients who were marker-negative and had small-volume metastasis. CR developed in 4 of 7 seminoma patients (57%) and in 7 of 25 marker-negative individuals (28%), and PR developed in 11 patients (44%) (RR = 72%). Out of 12 patients with small volume metastatis four (33%) showed CR and five revealed PR (41.7%), their RR turned out to be 74.6%. The average remission period was 37 (range 4-70) months in CR but merely 6.1 (range 2-38) months in PR. It can be stated that fairly good results can be achieved with second-line VpAP treatment in case of resistance developed to primary VPB therapy or subsequent relapse. The efficacy of combined chemotherapy of Vepesed+Holoxan +/- Adriablastin as third-choice was studied in advanced testicular cancer patients refractory to, or recurrent after, first- and second-line cytostatic therapy. Between September 1981 and January 1988 49 evaluable patients were treated with Vepesid (VP-16213--100 mg/m2 days 1-5), Holoxan (40 ml/kg days 1-5), hydration, urine-alkylation + Uromitexan +/- Adriablastin (40 mg/m day 1). The single dose of Uromitexan was 20% of the daily dose of Holoxan, and the patients received it i.v. just prior to Holoxan administration (h 0), the 4 and 8 h later. Two patients got into CR and 10 to PR. The rate of remission was 24.5%. The most severe side effect was leukopenia. The elevation of BUN and se. creatinine was transient and mild. In those cases where Holoxan was not included in the first- or second-line regimens, when combined with Vepesid and Adriablastin as third-choice therapy one could achieve further improvement. In case of CR the prolongation of life is also noteworthy. The first-, second- and third-line therapy plus salvage RLA and/or pulmonary metastasectomy achieved long-term survival only in one quarter of the patients.
abstract_ja: 190例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を修正Einhorn法で治療した。奏効率は67.9%であった。組織型が胎児性癌の症例(奏効率76.9%)、β-hCGおよびAFPがいずれも陰性の症例(奏効率97.4%)、肺病変の範囲が最小の群(奏効率94.1%)で最も良好な結果が得られた。VPB療法に抵抗性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍、および同療法後に再発した患者を含む112例に、ベプシド(100mg/m2を1〜5日目に点滴投与)、アドリアブラスチン(40mg/m2を1日目に点滴投与)およびシスプラチン(20mg/m2を1〜5日目に点滴投与)を投与した。完全奏効(CR)は18例(16.1%)、部分奏効(PR)は42例(37.5%)で、奏効率は53.6%であった。セミノーマで腫瘍マーカーが陰性かつ転移巣が小さい症例で最も良好な結果が得られた。セミノーマ7例中4例(57%)でCR、マーカー陰性25例中7例(28%)でCRが得られ、11例(44%)でPRが得られた(奏効率72%)。小転移巣の12例中、4例(33%)でCR、5例(41.7%)でPRが得られ、奏効率は74.6%であった。CRの平均寛解期間は37か月(4〜70か月)であったのに対し、PRでは6.1か月(2〜38か月)にとどまった。一次治療のVPBへの抵抗性または後続の再発に対する二次治療としてVpAP療法を用いれば、比較的良好な結果が得られると結論される。一次治療および二次治療に抵抗性または再発した進行精巣腫瘍患者49例を対象に、第三選択として併用化学療法(ベプシド、Holoxan±アドリアブラスチン)の効果を検討した。1981年9月から1988年1月までに、評価可能な49例を治療した。Holoxanの投与量は40ml/kgを1〜5日目に投与し、Uromitexanは、Holoxanの1日投与量の20%を、Holoxan投与直前(0時間)および投与後4時間と8時間に静脈内投与した。CRは2例、PRは10例で、寛解率は24.5%であった。最も重篤な副作用は白血球減少症であった。BUNおよび血清クレアチニンの上昇は一過性かつ軽度であった。一次または二次治療にHoloxanが含まれていなかった場合は、第三選択療法としてベプシドおよびアドリアブラスチンを併用することで、さらなる改善が得られた。CRの症例では、生存期間の延長も注目に値する。一次、二次、三次治療に加え、救済的な後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RLA)および/または肺転移切除を行うことで、長期生存は患者の4分の1のみで得られた。
